elements: LinkedIn link placeholder with clearly labeled '[LinkedIn URL Placeholder]'

components_and_ui.nav: Slim sticky top bar with backdrop-blur-md bg-stone-50/80 dark:bg-stone-900/80, brand badge 'Aditya, Out Loud', section scroll anchors, mobile drawer menu
components_and_ui.buttons: Pill or rounded-xl buttons with subtle hover lift (-translate-y-0.5), focus-visible ring-2 ring-orange-500, active click scale-95
components_and_ui.cards: Subtle border (border-stone-200), warm background (#FAF6F0), smooth shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all
components_and_ui.audio_player: Custom waveform seekbar, play/pause button with aria-label, duration display, transcript toggle drawer
components_and_ui.badges: Rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-mono font-medium border border-orange-200 bg-orange-50 text-orange-700

motion_and_interactions.soundwave_canvas: Interactive animated bars with custom frequency wave simulator
motion_and_interactions.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion CSS query by disabling transform animations

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rule: Every interactive element (buttons, cards, audio controls, input fields, accordion triggers, tab buttons) MUST include a unique data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
accessibility_and_testing.aria_labels: All audio controls, mobile menu toggles, and icon-only buttons must have descriptive aria-label attributes.
accessibility_and_testing.no_autoplay: Audio element MUST NOT have autoplay attribute under any circumstances.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use warm cream palette (#FDFBF7) with rich dark charcoal text (#1F1E1B) and warm energetic orange accents (#EA580C).
Implement the voice-themed soundwave hero visual using SVG/Canvas with interactive frequency wave animations.
Ensure all project cards expand smoothly with complete details (Problem, Contribution, Decision, Learning, Links).
Include full audio player functionality with transcript panel toggle and step-by-step revision explanation.
Make sure all workspace setup items display '[cost TBD]' as required by user instructions.
Clearly label all missing logistics items ([LinkedIn Placeholder], [Availability Placeholder], [Bangalore Preference Placeholder]).
Ensure data-testid is attached to all buttons, links, inputs, and clickable elements.
